meta.title: K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN | Not Just a Stay. Live Tokyo Beautifully.
meta.description: K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN is a 3-room design apartment stay steps away from Shinjuku Gyoen, each room styled by a different furniture brand. Live Tokyo the way you'd actually live it.

hero.titleLine1: Stay steps away from Shinjuku Gyoen.
hero.titleLine2: Design Apartments in the Heart of Tokyo.
hero.description: K3V SHINJUKU GYOEN is a 3-room design apartment building just steps from Shinjuku Gyoen. UNICO, JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE, and CRASH GATE — each room carries a different furniture brand's world. Not a sightseeing base, but a stay that feels like everyday life in Tokyo.
hero.illustrationAlt: Illustration of a room near Shinjuku Gyoen with a potted plant and a coffee cup by the window, overlooking the Tokyo skyline

pillars.title: A Nordic-natural morning
pillars.text: The warmth of wood and soft Nordic fabrics. ROOM 01, furnished by UNICO, makes an ordinary morning feel a little more thoughtful.

pillars.title: An urban-vintage night
pillars.text: The texture of well-worn leather and brass. ROOM 02 by JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE is for those who want an evening that fits the city night.

pillars.title: Industrial breathing room
pillars.text: ROOM 03 by CRASH GATE balances rawness with comfort. Steel and brass details add a spoonful of edge to everyday living.

rooms.description: Each of the three rooms carries a different way of living, chosen by a different furniture brand. Even steps from the same Shinjuku Gyoen, the room you choose shows you a slightly different face of the day.

items.name: ROOM 01
items.subtitle: Natural Living
items.text: A natural room by UNICO, layering solid-wood furniture with the softness of Nordic fabrics. A quiet that never grows tiresome, for those staying as if they lived here.
items.alt: Image of a Nordic-natural room by UNICO

items.name: ROOM 02
items.subtitle: Urban Vintage
items.text: A room built around well-worn leather, brass, and furniture from JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE. A little bolder, for those who want an evening that fits the city night.
items.alt: Image of an urban-vintage room by JOURNAL STANDARD FURNITURE

items.name: ROOM 03
items.subtitle: Industrial Modern
items.text: A room by CRASH GATE that balances rawness with comfort. Steel and brass details add a spoonful of edge to everyday living. (Details coming soon)
items.alt: Image of an industrial-modern room by CRASH GATE

moments.headingLine2: the Tokyo that lives between daily moments.

items.title: A morning with steam rising
items.text: The first cup of coffee, brewed from beans sourced at a local roaster. Window cracked open, feeling the green of Shinjuku Gyoen carry the morning air in.

items.title: A rest on the balcony
items.text: Making time to do nothing in a patch of sun. Even while traveling, letting your shoulders drop the way you would at home.

items.title: A quiet book at night
items.text: One lamp on, opening the book you brought along. A night with the sound of turning pages instead of the television.

access.description: A small, three-room stay steps from Shinjuku Gyoen and within walking distance of Shinjuku Station. Convenience stores and supermarkets nearby make it easy for travelers and long-stayers alike.
